purpose: S5 (appearance and content interleaved): appearance-only requests must not change the text, every PDF must compile, and every requested style must still be in the final PDFs.
correct_behaviour: Text unchanged on every appearance turn; every PDF compiles; the final CV has dark green headings and a sans-serif font, the letter a dark green name; the job is removed.

requests.text: Make the section headings in the CV PDF dark green.
Now use a sans-serif font for the CV PDF.
requests.correct_behaviour: Sans-serif font; headings still dark green; text unchanged.

requests.text: Please remove the Customer Support Specialist job from the CV.
Tighten the spacing and margins in the CV PDF a little. Don't change the wording.
requests.correct_behaviour: Tighter layout; text unchanged; styles kept.

requests.text: Make my name at the top of the cover letter PDF dark green too, to match the CV.
requests.correct_behaviour: Letter name dark green; text of both documents unchanged.

checks.what: the dark-green request left both texts unchanged
the font request left both texts unchanged
the spacing request left both texts unchanged
the letter style request left both texts unchanged
every PDF made compiled from the system's own LaTeX (no plain fallback)
final CV LaTeX still has the green headings
final CV LaTeX still has the sans-serif font
final letter LaTeX has the green name
